scenarios.title: Quick checkout smoke
scenarios.description: Start the isolated checkout stack and repeat one order with the same request key.
scenarios.expectation: One confirmed order and one payment effect after the repeat.

scenarios.title: Normal baseline vs candidate
scenarios.description: Compare the baseline with two replicas, a 10-second catalog cache and queued notifications.
scenarios.expectation: Measured latency, CPU and recovery spread for both configurations.

scenarios.title: Flash sale comparison
scenarios.description: Replay the flash-sale workload against the baseline and a three-replica cached candidate.
scenarios.expectation: A measured comparison under sustained concurrent checkout traffic.

scenarios.title: Payment timeout with unsafe retry
scenarios.description: Lose the payment reply, retry without idempotency, and check the payment ledger.
scenarios.expectation: Gate rejection with I-01 and three payment effects for one request key.
